method: Second method, asked for by Obay on 2026-11-21: (1) split the part into sections that each carry one deep meaning, written as one plain sentence; (2) write picture ideas for each section; (3) judge them: which shows the deep meaning most truly, then which a watcher understands at once while hearing the words, then which is most engaging; (4) make the top two for each picture slot as real pictures ("candidates") and choose by eye.

sections.meaning: Choose by what a person truly is and not by what impresses you: a believing slave is better than one who gives God partners, even if the other impresses you.
ideas: A hand passes over a bouquet of showy plastic flowers and reaches for a small real plant in a plain pot
A glittering showy car beside a plain sturdy farm truck, a hand taking the truck keys
A mirror-ball beside a steady lamp

sections.meaning: Do not make God, by your oaths, an obstacle to being virtuous, mindful and setting things right between people; idle talk in oaths is not held against you, but what your hearts have earned is.
ideas: A man stands outside a door he has sworn not to enter while a neighbor inside leans from the window for help
A man frozen in a doorway with a raised hand while a child waits to be helped

sections.meaning: A man who swears off his wife waits four months and may come back; divorced women wait their time; keep them as is right or let them go in a good way, and do not keep them to harm them or prevent them from marrying.
ideas: A man at a gate with a hand on the latch looking back at a lit house
A woman waits at a window as snow turns to spring outside
A couple part calmly at a front gate while he carries her suitcase to the car
A man stands aside and holds open a gate for a couple to pass

sections.meaning: Mothers nurse for two full years and the father provides food and clothing as is right; no soul is burdened beyond its capacity; widows wait four months and ten, and a man must not push a proposal in secret.
ideas: A father's hands bring a tray of food and a folded blanket to a mother resting in a chair with a baby on her lap
A father carries a tired mother's bags up a stair while she holds the baby
A man stops his hand before knocking on a woman's door and puts it in his pocket

sections.meaning: Support those you divorce, the rich according to his means and the poor according to his means; for you to pardon is nearer to mindfulness, and do not forget bounty between yourselves.
ideas: A rich man's thick envelope and a poor man's few coins each handed over with the same dignity
A man tears an IOU in two and hands the pieces back with a smile

sections.meaning: Watch over the prayers and stand obedient to God; in fear, on foot or riding; when safe, remember him as he taught you what you did not know.
ideas: One person stands quietly with head bowed in a busy street while the crowd flows around
A worker lays down his tools and kneels on a plain mat in the corner of a workshop at midday
A rider keeping steady at a gallop with one hand raised at dusk

sections.meaning: For widows there is support for the year without being driven out, and for divorced women support as is right, a duty on those who are mindful of God; so God makes his signs clear for people to use their reason.
ideas: An old woman in her own kitchen while neighbors bring bread and soup
A neighbor fixes the roof of a widow's house while her children watch from the porch
